While developing a new security policy, the network administrator suggests removing the password age portion. Why has having a password age policy caused issues for companies? (Select the two best options.)
options: Password age policies allow for more secure passwords.
Employees leave passwords readily accessible in their work area.
Employees choose weak passwords when they need to change them frequently.
Employees follow best practices regarding passwords.
answer: Employees leave passwords readily accessible in their work area.
Employees choose weak passwords when they need to change them frequently.

An engineering firm wants to implement an authentication design that uses a framework for passwordless authentication. What statement is not accurate regarding passwordless authentication?
options: When presented with an authentication challenge, the user performs the local gesture to unlock the private key.
The user registers with a web application or service, referred to as a relying party.
The user chooses either a roaming authenticator or a platform authenticator implemented by the device OS.
The relying party uses a private key to verify the signature and authenticate the account session.
answer: The relying party uses a private key to verify the signature and authenticate the account session.
